// Screen-space ambient occlusion controls. Radius is the occlusion search
// distance in scene units; Intensity scales the darkening; Bias offsets
// samples to avoid self-occlusion; SampleCount trades quality for speed.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ambient_occlusion)
type AmbientOcclusionSettings
    implements IValue
{
    Enabled: Boolean;
    Radius: Number;
    Intensity: Number;
    Bias: Number;
    SampleCount: Integer;
}
